companyInfo: 株式会社SINDは、病院向け看護記録AI「Caretomo」を展開するヘルステックスタートアップです。既存の生成AI技術と独自のAI技術を統合し、病棟看護師の業務負担軽減を支援しており、全国の病院への導入が拡大しています。2024年2月に創業し、長野県長野市に本社を置いています。Caretomoは話すだけで毎日の記録が作れる「会話型」の看護記録作成AI支援システムです。
industry: インターネット・Webサービス
jobCategory: フロントエンドエンジニア（エンジニア）
jobContent:
■仕事概要
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will own product development across the stack, from backend systems to frontend experiences. You will work closely with AI engineers and clinicians to deliver features used in real clinical settings. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys strong ownership, fast iteration, and building systems that directly improve healthcare operations.
Responsibilities
Own end-to-end product features from backend APIs to frontend UI
Design, build, and scale core application architecture and database infrastructure
Develop and maintain systems using Postgres, AWS RDS Aurora, and cloud-native services
Integrate real-time AI services such as speech recognition, summarization, and NLU through AWS and Azure
Deploy, optimize, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS
Collaborate closely with AI engineers, product members, and clinicians to ship impactful features
Improve system reliability, performance, and developer productivity
Perform additional engineering responsibilities as needed in a fast-moving startup environment
Senior level
Hiring Process
Document screening
1–2 interviews (Including a technical interview.)
Final decision

must:
3+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
Strong backend development skills with technologies such as Nextjs, Django, FastAPI, Node.js, AWS Lambda, Postgres, and SQL
Solid frontend development experience
Strong product mindset with the ability to think across the full system
Comfortable working in a global team
Based in Japan, with the ability to commute to Tokyo
Business English
※No Japanese language skills required
